name: 鎌倉
blurb: An old seaside town. Near the station: a shrine for charms and a souvenir shop.

name: 秋葉原
blurb: Tokyo's Electric Town. Out of the 電気街口 exit: an electronics shop, a maid cafe, an arcade, and capsule-toy machines on the street.

name: 横浜
blurb: A harbour city with a big Chinatown.

name: 箱根
blurb: Hot springs in the mountains. Stay the night at a ryokan: a bath, dinner in your room and a futon. ¥9,800 a night, paid when you check out.

name: 日光
blurb: Bright old shrines deep in the cedar forest.
